name: P-Valley
description: Down deep in the Mississippi Delta, Trap music meets film noir in this kaleidoscopic story of a little-strip-club-that-could and the big characters who come through its doors—the hopeful, the lost, the broken, the ballers, the beautiful, and the damned.

videos.title: Perpetratin'
videos.overview: Autumn Night, a mysterious beauty with a harrowing past washes up on the shores of the Pynk seeking employment. Mercedes Sundayz, a night headlined by the club's OG, brings unexpected trouble from a number of patrons.

videos.title: Scars
videos.overview: The Pynk's annual carwash receives a visit from a surprising guest while Autumn's past comes back to haunt her. Back at the club, souls are bared, and deals are negotiated in the private booths.

videos.title: Higher Ground
videos.overview: Autumn dons a bold new look and learns the rules of working a "regular" from The "Trinity," each of whom receives a visit from her favorite repeat customer. Uncle Clifford learns about big changes coming to Chucalissa.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Mercedes and Autumn make major moves toward building new lives for themselves. At the Pynk, gossip spreads like wildfire, and patrons flood in for a big night.

videos.title: Belly
videos.overview: Two foes find themselves trapped together for a weekend under unlikely circumstances. Keyshawn reaches new heights, and Lil' Murda glows up big time.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: All throughout the Pynk, surprising new bonds are formed as everyone fights to secure their bag and their future. Andre faces pushback on his deal with the warring Kyle brothers.

videos.title: Last Call For Alcohol
videos.overview: Uncle Clifford goes to war for the hearts and minds of Chucalissa.;back at the club, the Pynk family comes together to prepare for its biggest night yet.

videos.title: Murda Night
videos.overview: Folks from Biloxi to Atlanta pack out the Pynk to see two shining stars on a unforgettable night. Meanwhile, Autumn's past finally catches up with her. Season Finale.

videos.title: Pussyland
videos.overview: Still reeling from the events of Murda Night, the Pynk family faces off against a new foe: Rona.

videos.title: Seven Pounds of Pressure
videos.overview: While The Pynk staff prepares for their biggest night yet, Uncle Clifford reaches a personal milestone.

videos.title: The Dirty Dozen
videos.overview: Keyshawn and Lil’ Murda embark on a new adventure. Meanwhile, Mercedes ventures into uncharted territory.

videos.title: Demethrius
videos.overview: While Keyshawn’s glow-up continues, Big Teak struggles with life on the outside. Back in Chucalissa, The Pynk is visited by a surprise guest.

videos.title: White Knights
videos.overview: Sit on down and get ready to learn the history of Mississippi...

videos.title: Savage
videos.overview: Andre’s mayoral campaign picks up speed as Autumn and Uncle Clifford wage war. Mercedes finds herself further entangled in Memphis. Back in Chucalissa, Lil’ Murda helps Big Teak find his footing in a broken new world.

videos.title: Jackson
videos.overview: Uncle Clifford wrestles with her future while opening the door to the past. Meanwhile, Mercedes struggles with the complexities of motherhood.

videos.title: The Death Drop
videos.overview: Some folks across Chucalissa fight for what’s theirs, while others struggle to accept the things they can’t change.

videos.title: Snow
videos.overview: The Pynk framily shows up and shows out, giving folks a night they won’t ever forget...

videos.title: Mississippi Rule
videos.overview: It’s the big finale, y’all. New beginnings and endings abound in Chucalissa.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 17 wins & 46 nominations total
